content.content:
## How to Use Templates

1. Click any template link above to download the JSON
2. Copy the JSON content
3. Replace your `site.json` with the template
4. Refresh your browser to see the new site
5. Customize as needed!

All templates are fully functional examples you can learn from and build upon.
